$comment: Single source of truth for K3s homelab node identity and safety constraints. Consumed by WindowsLab/HomelabNodes.psm1 -> Start-K3sHomelab.ps1, Stop-K3sHomelab-Minimal.ps1, shutdown_homelab.ps1. Do not hardcode node lists in those scripts.

nodes.name: nuc
nodes.notes: K3s control plane and API server endpoint. Never cordon/drain: the API lives here.

nodes.name: kubernetes1
nodes.notes: General worker. Hosts iiq db-mysql after recovery.

nodes.name: kubernetes2
nodes.notes: General worker. Hosts iiq db after recovery.

nodes.name: kubernetes5
nodes.notes: Minimal-mode survivor (kept running with nuc + kubernetes7 during power-down).

nodes.name: kubernetes7
nodes.notes: PERMANENT SURVIVOR: physical power switch is broken, so a power-off is unrecoverable. NEVER cordon, drain or power it off. Carries the largest workload share while other nodes are down.

nodes.name: kubernetes8-debian
nodes.notes: Debian worker. Frequently powered off during minimal mode; expect it NotReady with stale Longhorn instance-managers.

external.name: registry
external.notes: Local docker registry on port 5000; pinned by kube-system/registry-fixer.
